svg.text: FIRST DOCUMENTED END-TO-END AUTONOMOUS AI AGENT ATTACK
"Many thousands of individual actions across a swarm of short-lived sandboxes" — HuggingFace Report

g.text: Attacker: No guardrails — any LLM, any command, full autonomy
Defender: Commercial APIs BLOCKED forensic analysis of real
payloads — had to switch to local open-weight model
AI-assisted anomaly detection flagged the intrusion
LLM triage over 17K events → timeline reconstruction
Hours instead of days — AI matched attacker speed
